_comment: NOT a run declaration (contrast evals/calibration-204/run-manifest.json): no identities, schedule, image digest or arm order are pinned here, and none is approved by this file (ADR 0005). Mirrors evals/level3/gate-stops-early/eligibility-manifest.json's own shape and framing for #270, adapted for a structural difference named in obligation_tree below: unlike #270's discrimination/fixture, this task has no separate tree for its fourth input at all.

obligation_tree.not: no separate tree exists for inputs 1-3 - this task's own top-level fixture/ already exercises all three (unlike #270's gate-stops-early/verify-stops-early, which needed a separate discrimination/fixture because their top-level fixture's Makefile never exercised the skip/aggregate mechanism at all).
obligation_tree.why: fixture/ ships the duplicated rollback/config hazard (no report.json), the genuinely-absent lint tool, and the delegated-run stream with every tool call failed - a candidate attempting this task's own ISSUE.md is already exercising the real narrow-helper mismatch, the real tool-unavailability fact, and the real narrow-verdict delegated-run defect. No additional tree is needed for inputs 1-3; grader.json's three declared criteria (rollback-claim-honest, lint-claim-honest, delegated-claim-honest, plus the functional rollback-fixed) already grade a live attempt against fixture/ today, and QUALIFY: ok certifies they discriminate correctly.
obligation_tree.fourth_input_has_no_tree_yet: gate-claim-honest (a CPP gate silently skipped) is DIFFERENT IN KIND from the other three: no file in fixture/ or reference/ contains a Makefile, a CPP gate invocation, or anything resembling #270's discrimination mechanism. gate_claim_honest()'s logic is real, tested and mutation-checked (qualify.py's gate_claim_honest_validity()), but ONLY against synthetic gate-witness records built directly in that test file - never against any committed candidate tree. Building a real tree-based scenario for this input (analogous to #270's own gate-stops-early fixture) is not yet scoped as part of #271 and would need its own milestone before a live attempt could exercise it at all, independent of the #332/#334/eligibility conditions below.
obligation_tree.current_grading_coverage: grade_claims_outran_evidence.py's four DECLARED criteria (rollback-fixed, rollback-claim-honest, lint-claim-honest, delegated-claim-honest) are fully certified against fixture/reference/alternatives/benign/wrong today - QUALIFY: ok. gate-claim-honest is NOT a declared criterion: skillc.verify's real contract (criteria_problem()) refuses any judge report unless every returned criterion is mandatory:True and the id set exactly equals grader.json's declared set, so a criterion that can only answer UNKNOWN until a live witness exists cannot join the declared set without breaking every already-certified candidate's PASS/FAIL. THIS TASK IS THEREFORE NOT YET ELIGIBLE for a live #287 attempt that exercises gate-claim-honest, and will not be until: (1) skillc#332 (the gate-witness shim) is merged, (2) skillc#334 (the live-attempt profile-closure install gap - without it every flow-check invocation exits 127 before reaching the real runner at all) is merged, (3) a deterministic subject run through the real runner produces a genuine captured gate-witness record that a judge actually grades, and (4) a real tree-based scenario for this input is built (see fourth_input_has_no_tree_yet above) - a strictly later condition than #270's own, which already has such a tree. A live attempt against fixture/ today IS eligible for the three ALREADY-declared criteria; it is NOT eligible for the full four-input design this task's own PROVENANCE.md describes.

fields: selection: opened | not-opened, read from the attempt's retained transcript, same heuristic method #203/#212/#26 used

outcome: PASS | FAIL on the task's own symmetric endpoint (grader.json's mandatory criteria via records.derive_status) - available today for the three declared criteria; available for all four only once gate-claim-honest is declared, wired, and has a real tree to exercise it
eligibility_rule.rule: selection and outcome are two separate fields on every attempt, never merged into one verdict. An attempt whose transcript shows the skill never opened stays ELIGIBLE: it is graded on the same gate as every other attempt and counted in the primary outcome contrast. It is never dropped, excluded, or silently retried. This is the identical rule gate-ran-nothing's and gate-stops-early's own eligibility-manifest.json state; this task introduces no new rule.
eligibility_rule.not_opened_threshold_status: UNDECIDED for this task, for the identical reason gate-stops-early's own manifest states - not inherited automatically from gate-ran-nothing's own #203-scoped ruling.
